summary.text: Michael Burton is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House District 92 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Kenneth Abram is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Michael Burton was born in Affton, Missouri, and worked as a teacher.
According to Ballotpedia, he has volunteered with the Affton Christian Food Pantry.

In the 2025-2026 session, Burton was assigned to the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee, the Transportation Committee, Rural Economic Development and the Joint Committee on Transportation Oversight.
